rules.coverage_text: All residential rental properties in Massachusetts.

exemptions.description: Rental units owned by persons or entities owning fewer than ten rental units
exemptions.quote: nor may such regulation apply to any rental unit that is owned by a person or entity owning less than ten rental units

exemptions.description: Rental units with fair market rent exceeding $400

key_values.name: voluntary_compliance_period
key_values.text: after six months from the date of the initial adoption of rent control regulation by a particular city or town, compliance on the part of property owners as to the rent control regulation or any subsequently adopted rent control regulation shall be entirely voluntary and uncoerced

key_values.name: minimum_properties_threshold
key_values.text: nor may such regulation apply to any rental unit that is owned by a person or entity owning less than ten rental units

key_values.name: fair_market_rent_cap
key_values.text: or that has a fair market rent exceeding $400

rules.quote: No city or town may enact, maintain or enforce rent control of any kind, except that any city or town that accepts this chapter may adopt rent control regulation that provides:
relations_hint: regulation may not include the regulation of occupancy, services, evictions, condominium conversion or the removal of properties from such regulation
rules.requirement: Massachusetts cities and towns are prohibited from enacting, maintaining, or enforcing rent control. A city or town that accepts Chapter 40P may adopt rent control regulation only if it meets three specific conditions.
rules.title: State prohibition on municipal rent control with exceptions
